recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white full-body studio portrait of a female figure against a stark white background. The subject is centered, wearing distressed low-rise denim with lace-up details, posed with arms raised. The composition is flanked by wide-tracked lowercase typography at the waistline and a script-style subtitle in the bottom left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically between two blocks of horizontal text
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows against a pure white void
Juxtaposition of structured, wide-set display type and fluid, organic script
Verticality of the subject's pose balanced by horizontal text alignment
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette
Pure white background with no horizon line
Extreme letter-spacing in the primary display text
Subject's arms raised above the head to create a tall, narrow silhouette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure centered, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's torso and the horizontal line created by the primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the primary text, then follows the legs down to the script in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subject, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the denim texture
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses lowercase characters with wide, circular bowls
Secondary text uses a fluid, slanted cursive with long ascenders and descenders
Extreme horizontal tracking in the primary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a round bowl and short tail
Script 's' with a dramatic lead-in stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a modern, spaced-out sans-serif and a traditional, expressive script.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura or ITC Avant Garde Gothic
candidateDirections.reason: Geometric lowercase forms match the primary text skeleton.
Elegant, high-contrast script for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio portrait of a woman in distressed low-rise jeans, arms raised over her head, high-contrast black and white photography, pure white background, sharp focus on denim texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase geometric sans-serif text across the middle, split into two words flanking the subject with extreme tracking. Add a small, elegant script word in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text lowercase with extreme tracking?
Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the script text placed in the bottom left?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text tracking is wide enough to feel intentional
Verify the script text is legible but delicate
Confirm high-contrast shadow detail in the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochrome studio portrait with a dual-font typographic layout: one wide-tracked geometric sans-serif split horizontally, and one delicate script anchored in a corner.
